actions.name: Glide
actions.description: Add 30 feet to the maximum height of your Power Jump. The mech floats until your next turn or falls at a rate of 5 feet per round.

description.value:
Prerequisite: Requires thrusters.

Winglike extensions enable extended flight capabilities.

Glide (1 PP): Add 30 feet to the maximum height of your Power Jump. The mech floats until your next turn or falls at a rate of 5 feet per round.
